title: The train to the airport
instructions: Bir turist istasyonda havalimanı trenini soruyor. Saat, peron ve fiyattaki bilgileri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: tourist
script.text: Excuse me. Which train goes to the airport?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The Airport Express. It leaves every fifteen minutes.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It's ten past nine now, so the next one is at nine fifteen. Then nine thirty.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Platform two. But today it is platform three, because of work on the tracks.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Twelve pounds, or eight pounds with a student card.

script.speaker: tourist
script.text: I'm not a student. One ticket, please.

questions.prompt: How often does the Airport Express leave?
questions.feedback: Havalimanı treni on beş dakikada bir kalkıyor.

questions.prompt: If the tourist takes the next train, when will she arrive?
Which platform does the train leave from today?
questions.feedback: Normalde iki ama bugün ray çalışması nedeniyle üç numaralı peron.
questions.evidence: But today it is platform three

questions.prompt: How much does the tourist pay?
questions.feedback: Öğrenci olmadığı için on iki pound ödüyor.
